query: I'm designing "Out-of-Tree Credential Providers" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "Bound Service Account Token Flow". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, the "Bound Service Account Token Flow" was considered as an alternative approach (suggested in [kubernetes/kubernetes#68810](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/68810)).

Under this approach, an image pull flow built on bound service account tokens would provide the kubelet with credentials to pull images for pods running as a specific service account.

It was not adopted because it was determined to be **out of scope for extracting the cloud provider-specific code**, although it was noted that it might be better suited as a future enhancement to either the credential provider or `ImagePullSecrets`.
